quote: getTables() is called without a schema
author: Santos Sabanari

quote: It reads structure only, meaning tables, columns, keys, and indexes, and never queries row data, so you don't need to point an external GUI client at the database or regenerate a static diagram every time you run a migration.
author: Yannick Lyn Fatt

quote: I saw a new Laravel package to view/export/review your database schema, with just one "composer require" and zero configuration.
author: Povilas Korop

quote: On larger SaaS codebases, understanding how tables relate to each other is something that usually requires either a paid GUI tool or a manually maintained diagram that drifts over time.
author: Mohamed Said

quote: It caught a few schema issues that I had overlooked, which honestly made me appreciate the package even more. I can definitely see it being useful as a quick schema health check as a project grows. And now it is installed in all of my personal projects.
author: Haydar Ali Awan

quote: Inheriting a messy codebase used to cost me days of figuring out how the data is structured and how the tables connect. Now it takes 10 minutes.
author: Haseeb Mirza

quote: مستندسازی فقط نوشتن یک فایل توضیحات نیست؛ گاهی خود ساختار سیستم بهترین مستندات ماست.
translation: Documentation is not only writing a file of explanations. Sometimes the structure of the system itself is our best documentation.
author: Ehsan Rafiee

quote: [Bug] Table connection prefix (`prefix` / `DB_PREFIX`) causes empty columns, keys, and foreign   key relationships
author: Nguyễn Tiến Lộc

quote: بتقرأ الـ schema الحقيقي من قاعدة البيانات، مش ملفات الـ migrations، فبتكون دايمًا محدثة
translation: It reads the real schema from the database, not the migration files, so it is always up to date.
author: Amr Lotfy Saleh

quote: The usual fix is opening an external database GUI client, or asking someone to redraw the diagram in a whiteboard tool — which, of course, goes stale the moment a new migration runs.
author: Developer Awam

quote: Sometimes the hardest part of working with a database isn't writing the query… It's understanding the database itself.
author: Bhavin Vaghadiya

quote: Instead of opening your DB client and jumping between tables, Laravel Truss gives you a live, interactive ER diagram directly inside your Laravel app.
author: Mohammad Ghanem

quote: نکته‌ی مهمش امنیته: فقط ساختار (جدول‌ها، ستون‌ها، کلیدها، ایندکس‌ها) رو می‌خونه و هیچ‌وقت به داده‌های واقعی جدول‌ها دسترسی نداره یا نمایششون نمی‌ده.
translation: The important part is the security: it reads only the structure, tables, columns, keys, indexes, and it never touches the real data in the tables or shows it.
author: Milad Niroee

quote: [Bug] Uncaught cache-store failure crashes `php artisan migrate` and the `/truss` dashboard
author: Hafiz Muhammad Moaz

contribution: Reported three problems, each fixed in the next release: a filter that emptied the diagram with no explanation, a table border drawn on three sides, and a Focus picker that was unusable on a large schema.
author: Alberto Peripolli

quote: Sometimes, a visual diagram explains a database much faster than reading 20 migration files.
author: Ghanshyam Ashra

quote: Instead of switching between Laravel, MySQL Workbench/phpMyAdmin and migration files just to understand the database structure, you can get a visual overview directly from the application.
author: Sandeep Verma

quote: False positive pivot-table warning for one-to-one table with unique user_id
author: Belabied Redouane

quote: Firefox truncates table names
author: Dirk

quote: بتقرأ الـ schema الحقيقي من قاعدة البيانات، مش ملفات الـ migrations، فبتكون دايمًا محدثة.
translation: It reads the real schema from the database, not the migration files, so it is always up to date.
author: @mohammed_FBeshr

quote: تتيح لك فهم علاقات الجداول فوراً في المتصفح، تتبع الفروقات بعد الـ Migrations، واكتشاف المفاتيح والفهارس المفقودة بدون قراءة البيانات الفعلية.
translation: It lets you understand how the tables relate straight away in the browser, track what changed after your migrations, and find the missing keys and indexes, all without reading the actual data.
author: Maigd Hammoud

quote: Need to understand a large Laravel database? Instead of opening dozens of migration files, Truss can generate a live interactive ER diagram.
author: Noman Hameed

quote: Instead of looking at the entire database, you can focus on one table and see its foreign-key relationships. That can make understanding an unfamiliar codebase much faster.
author: Keyur Dudhagara

quote: Truss is for once it's live, seeing what's actually there. Different moments in the same project.
author: Stelios Ioannides

quote: Lo escribe Alberto Arena, mantenedor del paquete Laravel Truss, en un ensayo publicado esta semana donde pone cifras a un debate que el open source viene esquivando: 281 estrellas en GitHub frente a 24.000 instalaciones en Packagist en su propio proyecto.
author: Equipo Ecosistema Startup

quote: Analizamos el paquete de Laravel Truss, con el cual, podemos ver el esquema de la base de datos en vivo y exportarla.
translation: We analyse the Laravel Truss package, with which we can see the database schema live and export it.
author: LibreDesarrollo
